The repaired candidate has been saved to `answer.json`.

The fix narrows the single failing goal (an RTE signed_overflow check on `sn = sn + 1`) by adding an upper-bound precondition `requires size < 2147483646;` to the function contract. With this bound, WP derives `sn < size < 2147483646`, so `sn + 1` cannot overflow (`sn <= 2147483644`), making the previously timing-out overflow goal trivially valid while all other already-passing goals (invariants, variant, assigns, `assigns \nothing`, and the original `assert(sn == size)`) remain unaffected. All original C tokens and the original assertion are preserved unchanged.
